newsitem.title: CHINA: China chemical exports to hit $20 bln/yr by 2000.
newsitem.headline: China chemical exports to hit $20 bln/yr by 2000.

text.p: Total foreign trade in China's chemical sector is forecast to reach $40 billion a year in 2000, with exports accounting for $20 billion, the Economic Daily said on Tuesday.
By the year 2000, about 100 new export-oriented chemical enterprises would be set up to compete on the international market, the newspaper quoted chemical industry Minister Gu Xiulian as saying.
Foreign funds invested in chemical firms would reach $12 billion by the year 2000, Gu said.
China exported $11.6 billion worth of chemical products in 1995 while total foreign investment in the sector totalled $6.0 billion as of last year, she said.
Nearly 80 Chinese chemical enterprises were now each capable of earning $10 million or more a year from exports, Gu said.
The ministry has said China's annual nationwide chemical sales will reach more than $100 billion by 2000.
